title: RenderingGen Overlay Prepare V1
description: PipelineGen's pre-timing warm-up document, submitted as an overlay.prepare job before audio timing exists. RenderingGen materializes the declared assets through the single asset resolver and stores the document content-addressably; it does NOT render. The later overlay.render job carries the frozen semantic renderinggen.overlay-plan.v1 plan. This contract has no Chronon counterpart by construction.

timing_state.description: Warm-up work is only valid while timing is unresolved. A resolved intent belongs on the overlay.render job's semantic plan.
